items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear Alonzo Ross? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I probably met him, a lot of the guys.

ctx.x: I don't know whether he might be Eagle Eye Shields, but he was the leader of that band. Edmund Hall played with Eagle Eye Shields. Well, I'm going to get to that, Edmund Hall was at, now I ain't going to Jacksonville, but the band was consistent of, like I told you, I go back to Joy Morris on trombone, the band on trumpet, Edmund Washington on sax and clandered, Edmund Hall on sax and clandered, Albert Morgan on bass. Oh, I forgot to tell you how I went, Joy Wynn, Joy Wynn had left, had left. And that's why we…
Did you ever hear Alonzo Ross? Alonzo Ross. Alonzo Ross, he was a piano player I think over there. From where? Around Jacksonville, I think.

Well, I probably met him, a lot of the guys. He went to New York. Yeah. Well, that happened years later because now I want to get, you still get on that same kick in Jacksonville. Now, Eagle Eyes had came out somewhere and heard our band. In fact, we even went up and sat in with the band. And he liked me, who I played bands, he liked the way Alvin Morgan played the bass, and he liked the way Edmund Hall played his playing and sax. And he wanted us to quit the band. That we had always promised that we would come…
